name: sandbox_manager
description: Runs Python in a Docker sandbox via execute_code. Compute, data analysis, image / PDF / document processing, OCR, file transformations. Pod I/O is first-class. Authority: AUTH_USER (99).

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: supporting context (names, dates, URLs, prior results) or ''

outputs.description: Human-readable result text from the planner loop.
Structured tool result payload (includes output_pod_ids for any minted output pods).

arguments_prompt:
sandbox_manager arguments:
- task: the compute / processing task.
- information: supporting context. Empty string allowed.

metadata.planner_description: Runs Python in a Docker sandbox: compute, data analysis, image/PDF/audio processing, file generation. Pods are first-class I/O.
